note: Both sets capture the core Cooking thresholds (5.000 lb / 80 oz / 2.268 kg for full points, 1.000–5.000 lb reduced, ≤16 oz no points, 96.00 oz starting weight) and both repeat the same reduced-point bounds many times. Set A invents a condition ('Home Entertainment Contest 9') for the 96 oz minimum and uses three quotes (the Figure 9 caption or the bare axis label) that do not support the claims attached to them. Set B adds correct facts A misses (two dinner parties during contest week; two people from each of the three neighboring houses) and has fewer unsupported quotes, but it does misquote the guest-list rule and wrongly states an 8-person limit per neighboring house, and it misbinds the 0–100% range to the final dinner party score. Net, B covers more of the page correctly despite one clear misread.
